## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive → Sector Strength; confirmations: sector breadth ≥7/11 and cyclicals/industrials leading (DE, GE, OXY ABOVE TREND). Leadership: Mixed (Top 5 span 3 sectors) — cyclical tilt, favor Value/Cyclical style.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +0.16%) ABOVE TREND; Energy strong: OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials strong: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials lagging: NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: +7.43%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples weak: WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION, MDLZ (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION. Technology mixed but internally rotating with several large-cap weaknesses (see below).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY; OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND; GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5) with cyclicals prominent.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND; WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION; DOW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: +7.43%) CORRECTION; ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech names and some cyclical profit-taking.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: multiple large caps (GOOGL RECOVERY, AMZN RECOVERY, UNH RECOVERY) show 1W/1M split — watch for trend break; treat moves as tactical.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed, internal rotation and selective strength. AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, but MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND — sector moving with pockets of leadership and dispersion.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive with select strength but mixed breadth; JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND and PYPL (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%) RECOVERY highlight rotation within the group; V (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND shows dispersion.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Calmer and defensive elements showing resilience but mixed signals. JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — news-driven pockets (see sentiment) could drive near-term moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals and select financials given RISK-ON: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to structurally weak large-cap Techs showing BELOW TREND (MSFT, ORCL, INTC). Style: Value/Cyclical, but monitor the major divergence in large caps — tactical entries preferred over broad exposures.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +2.22%), Energy (1W: +2.35%), Utilities (1W: +2.44%) — breadth supportive. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -0.45%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -0.28%) — watch dispersion and earnings/sentiment flows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) — sustain above this week’s highs to confirm ABOVE TREND momentum. DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) — hold 1M breakout levels to keep cyclical leadership intact. MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) — failure to reclaim 1M trend would keep it BELOW TREND and pressure Tech breadth.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
DE (+75): Deere surges on upbeat earnings — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) confirming sentiment. JNJ (+80): FDA breakthrough news — price CORRECTION (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) shows short-term pullback vs bullish catalyst (divergence to watch). LLY (+65): positive trial readout but stock BELOW TREND (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) — sentiment not yet reflected in price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (-50): negative report on Boeing programs and price BELOW TREND (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -7.21%) — sentiment confirmed. EL (-45): downgrade headlines but stock RECOVERY (1W: +7.34% | 1M: -3.09%) — price strength diverges from bearish headlines, monitor for distribution. (Note: broader bearish news list includes names without near-term price detail here.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style favored given broad sector strength (Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive). DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: Major 1W/1M divergences in large caps (GOOGL RECOVERY, AMZN RECOVERY, UNH RECOVERY) and mixed sentiment (JNJ +80 vs short-term weakness) — watch for trend confirmation before adding broad exposure.
